name: plan-guardian
description: Plan review workflow plugin with a plan-reviewer agent for rigorous plan quality checks. Non-blocking by default — Claude autonomously decides when to review, or users can trigger manually via /plan-review. v1.3.0 adds an opt-out codex review gate: a PreToolUse:ExitPlanMode hook intercepts plan-mode exits, instructs Claude to run /plan-guardian:codex-plan-review which loops `codex exec` against the plan and revises it until Codex emits NO_CONCERNS; the hook re-allows the original ExitPlanMode call only after a sha256 sentinel confirms the exact plan converged (set CODEX_PLAN_REVIEW=0 to disable). v1.4.0 adds /plan-guardian:setup, which adds scoped permission allow-rules so the codex loop's ./.plan-review/ writes stop prompting inside plan mode (state stays in ./.plan-review/, a non-protected path — never .claude/); the loop's mkdir + sentinel writes are consolidated into a pre-approvable plan-review-helper.sh.
